newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins Mannesmann mobile phone order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins Mannesmann mobile phone order.

text.p: German industrial giant Siemens AG said on Friday it won a 180 million mark order to supply equipment for the D2 mobile phone network of Mannesmann Mobilfunk GmbH.
Siemens would supply base stations and switching equipment to expand the digital D2 system, Germany's largest mobile network with more than 2.3 million customers.
Separately on Friday, Siemens said it won a mobile telephone order worth more than 350 million marks in Taiwan.
Under the order from Pacific Communications Services, Siemens would provide 1,200 base stations and network equipment for a cellular phone system expected to begin operating later this year.
